scope: Isolated MySQL 8.4 and Redis; controlled Apple transport and test-authority signed transactions. No real Apple requests, subscription mutation or deployment.
covered: Last pending binding acknowledgement re-queries every known chain, including previously acknowledged ones
Every requested chain must be returned and fully verified with stable token; no missing-response inference
Unknown related chains discovered during final reads persist atomically and prevent last acknowledgement
Mixed ownership entries for a discovered chain reject the complete chain; no partially matched records imported
Concurrent partial passes cannot both close the queue without a complete snapshot; last transaction rechecks readiness
New verified notification during provider reads changes revision and invalidates the old completion proof
Exact ordered purchase set, transaction anchors, signed timestamps, configured realm and deletion identity checked under locks
Proof lifetime below one minute; future/expired proof and expired worker lease rejected
Existing rebinding, identity, notification, retention, App Store transport and Gateway regression tests passed
not_completed: This closes the current known binding queue; it does not enumerate every historically unseen purchase
Final identity/billing/backup erasure transaction and account deletion HTTP/UI
Real Sandbox purchase, renewal, refund, legacy rebinding and account recreation acceptance
Deployment or activation; binding worker remains disabled by default
No native code changes or new Xcode run
